I told Marcus in their #north-team thread that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is **10 June**, not 25 November.

- **Why the date changed:** On 14 October Ilse posted 25 November in #north-team. Later that morning they posted a correction in #north-random saying it's 10 June, because they'd read the wrong line. GBrain has both notes, and the newer one replaces the old one.
- **Marcus can see the correction:** They're a member of #north-random, and so is everyone in #north-team, so mentioning it there doesn't expose anything. A renewal date isn't a finance figure, and Marcus owns the Brackenwater account anyway.
- **Year still unknown:** Neither of Ilse's posts gave a year, and I told Marcus that.

My first reply to Ilse in #north-team still says 25 November. My answer to Marcus in that channel now points to the correction.
